# braintrust_role (Resource)

Manages a custom Braintrust role. Roles are collections of permissions that can be granted via ACLs. Use the `braintrust_role` data source to reference built-in system roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a custom role with specific permissions
resource "braintrust_role" "dataset_manager" {
  name        = "Dataset Manager"
  description = "Can read and update datasets, but not delete them"

  member_permissions = [
    { permission = "read", restrict_object_type = "dataset" },
    { permission = "update", restrict_object_type = "dataset" },
    { permission = "create", restrict_object_type = "dataset" },
  ]
}

# Look up the built-in Viewer role
data "braintrust_role" "viewer" {
  name = "Viewer"
}

# Create a role that inherits from the built-in Viewer role
resource "braintrust_role" "viewer_plus" {
  name        = "Viewer Plus"
  description = "Viewer role plus the ability to create experiments"

  member_roles = [
    data.braintrust_role.viewer.id,
  ]

  member_permissions = [
    { permission = "create", restrict_object_type = "experiment" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the role.
- `member_permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions that belong to this role. Each entry is a (permission, restrict_object_type) tuple. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_permissions))
- `member_roles` (Set of String) IDs of roles this role inherits from. An inheriting role has all the permissions of its member roles.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of role creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of role deletion, or null if the role is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the role (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Organization the role belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the role.

<a id="nestedatt--member_permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_permissions`

Required:

- `permission` (String) The permission type. One of: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `create_acls`, `read_acls`, `update_acls`, `delete_acls`.

Optional:

- `restrict_object_type` (String) Optionally restricts the permission to a specific object type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the role ID.
terraform import braintrust_role.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
